howItWorks.title: How it works 🚀
howItWorks.description: Three simple steps to your perfect experience - fast, easy, and efficient!
step1.title: Register & Choose a Package
step1.description: Sign up with your email and select a suitable package. Start right away!
step2.title: Generate Your First Text
step2.description: Receive your first customized text for your housing application and your login details to access the platform.
step3.title: Use the Platform
step3.description: Enjoy all features: Generate messages for landlords with link input, create listings, track your generated texts, adjust your profile, and chat with the fine-tuned chatbot.

emailSection.description: 📧 Enter your email here to choose a tailored package for you. Additionally, a password will be generated so you can log in to the platform.

cta.benefit3: Support at every step of your search 👣
